description: A callee's return value feeding a predicate: `if (twice(n) > 3)`, with A editing the callee so the branch stops being taken and B an independent variable. Interprocedural flow meets control dependence here - A's edit reaches the guarded assignment only through the callee's formal-out and then the CDG - which no other fixture combines. Clean, and the merged program takes A's branch decision (out stays 0) with B's value.
